course.summary: We bring the training structure, instructors, and all PPE to your facility — with a syllabus built around the real hazards on your site.
prerequisites: A training area with adequate anchor structure, or we supply a portable tower
A medical fitness statement for each participant
outcomes: Competency that maps directly to your assets and procedures
A site-specific rescue plan, tested on the ground
A team competency matrix and a recommended progression path
Complete documentation for client and regulator audits

syllabus.title: Stage 1 — Site Visit & Analysis
syllabus.detail: A senior instructor surveys the site, maps the hazards, and agrees learning objectives with your HSE team.

syllabus.title: Stage 2 — Syllabus Design
syllabus.detail: Syllabus, rescue scenarios, and teaching materials written around your assets and SOPs.

syllabus.title: Stage 3 — Delivery
syllabus.detail: Training at your location, including all PPE, training structures, and photo-video documentation.

syllabus.title: Stage 4 — Report & Follow-up
syllabus.detail: Per-individual competency report, recommendations to improve the safe system of work, and a six-month review visit.

course.certificate: A RAC certificate, plus IRATA or BNSP certification where the programme includes a formal assessment.

sections.body:
## Training that is not generic

An open course teaches principles. In-house training teaches those principles on the structures your team actually climbs every day — your cooling tower, your tanks, your jetty.

## What HSE gets out of it

Every in-house programme produces a tested, site-specific rescue plan rather than a template document. That evidence carries real weight in client audits and Ministry of Manpower inspections.

sections.title: Secure your seat on the next cohort
sections.text: Send your name, the number of participants, and the month you are aiming for. We confirm seat availability and paperwork the same working day.
